guitar.evidence: Carl Perkins is documented playing a Gibson ES-5 Switchmaster (visible on the 'Blue Suede Shoes' era) and also used Gretsch models; well known but not a single iconic signature instrument on the level of Buddy Holly's Strat.

tone.target: bright slapback rockabilly twang with clean tube snap
tone.profile: bright slapback rockabilly twang with clean tube snap
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain emphasizing punchy attack and vintage tube warmth, utilizing a light boost and US Deluxe amp model for classic rockabilly twang.
